body.x: TRANSPORTER(www.filetransporter.com) presented private cloud 'Private' and 'Private sync' at 'Digital Experience' of the 'CES 2014', the biggest IT appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
It automatically sync files to private cloud, between all user digital devices. Then whenever can access it if users need. And automatically protected privately share anything.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance.More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
